purpose: Exact fixture controllers used for the October Linux release review; replay from their original paths after provisioning isolated directories, binaries and ephemeral credentials. They reuse the committed console impact workload and verdict, and add SSH supervision and cross-host TLS transport.

safety.management_transport: validated HTTPS plus separate domain-separated peer key
safety.keys: Owner-only fixture keys and ephemeral credentials are intentionally absent from this artifact.
safety.process_ownership: Supervisor records PID, command and exit status; stop refuses a command outside the owned remote root. Existing user checkout and processes are untouched.

replay_inputs: ReleaseFast console and console-free cluster binaries with identical application revision
Validated GeoIP snapshot and recorded digest
Private challenge seed, console key, peer key and consensus secret files
Ephemeral CA and distinct node certificates with CA constraints, key usage, authority identifiers and matching agyXX.incus DNS names
Caddy TLS ingress and local origin on each node
wrk and official supplied Anubis binary
Node 22 for Wasm UI behavior tests

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Three real Linux hosts, retaining the existing SID impact workload and verdict."""
import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import http.client
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex
import socket
import ssl
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT / "benchmarks"), str(ROOT / "tools")]
import console_impact as impact
import console_e2e as h
import console_peer_impact as peers
import console_totp_test as totp
import console_peer_fixture as fixture
from console_ws_test import Stream
from console_topics_client import Client
from console_dashboard import difference

HOSTS = [f"10.175.52.{last}" for last in (19, 20, 21)]
REMOTE = "/home/insan/sibuna-launch-20261001"
DATA, CONSOLE, TLS, CONSENSUS, ORIGIN = 39101, 39102, 39103, 39104, 39105
CACHE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TUNNELS, PORTS, ENVIRONMENTS = [], [], []
PROCESSES = []
SERIAL = 0
RUN_ID = str(int(time.time()))


def ssh(index, args, timeout=150):
    result = subprocess.run(["ssh", "-o", "BatchMode=yes", "-o", "ConnectTimeout=10",
                             f"insan@{HOSTS[index]}", shlex.join(args)],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f"host {index + 1}: {result.stderr[-2000:]}")
    return result


def agent(index, operation, value=None):
    result = ssh(index, ["python3", REMOTE + "/control/agent.py", operation,
                         json.dumps(value or {})])
    return json.loads(result.stdout)


class Process:
    def __init__(self, index, name, args):
        self.index, self.name, self.args = index, name, args
        self.pid = agent(index, "launch", {"name": name, "args": args})["pid"]
        self.returncode = None
        PROCESSES.append(self)

    def poll(self):
        return self.returncode

    def stop(self):
        if self.returncode is None:
            self.returncode = agent(self.index, "stop", {"name": self.name})["status"]
        if self.returncode != 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"node {self.index + 1} {self.name} exit {self.returncode}")


class Mesh(peers.Mesh):
    def __init__(self, root, ports):
        self.ports = ports

    def args(self, index):
        args = ["--console-behind-proxy", "--console-origin", "https://console.test",
                "--console-trusted-proxy", "127.0.0.1/32", "--console-key-file",
                REMOTE + "/control/console.key", "--console-peer-key-file",
                REMOTE + "/control/peer.key", "--console-peer-ca-file",
                REMOTE + "/control/peer.pem"]
        for other, host in enumerate(HOSTS):
            if other != index:
                args += ["--console-peer", f"{other + 1}=https://agy{other + 1:02}.incus:{TLS}"]
        return args

    def close(self):
        pass

    def credentials(self, temporary):
        credentials, secret, step, recovery = totp.enroll(self, self.ports[1], temporary, True)
        self.login_credentials, self.recovery = credentials, recovery[1:]
        return dict(credentials, code=recovery[0])

    def login(self, index):
        value = dict(self.login_credentials, code=self.recovery.pop(0))
        code, headers, body = self.request(self.ports[index], "POST", "/console/api/login", value)
        assert code == 200, (code, body)
        return headers["Set-Cookie"].split(";", 1)[0], json.loads(body)["csrf"]

    def ready(self, cookie):
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 45
        rows = []
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            rows = self.snapshot(cookie)
            if peers.current(rows, require_geo=False):
                return
            time.sleep(1)
        print("Management startup reports:", json.dumps(rows), flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError("six authenticated management directions did not become current")


class Daemon(impact.Daemon):
    def __init__(self, name, binary, temp, cluster, seed, psk, settings):
        self.name, self.binary, self.temp, self.cluster = name, binary, temp, cluster
        self.seed, self.psk, self.settings = seed, psk, settings
        self.procs, self.logs, self.clients = [], [], []
        self.target_proc = None
        self.port = PORTS[0][0]
        self.console_port = PORTS[0][1] if name in ("idle", "active") else None
        self.consoles = [pair[1] for pair in PORTS] if self.console_port else []
        self.mesh = Mesh(temp, self.consoles) if self.consoles else None
        self.helper = self.mesh or h

    def cluster_args(self, index, unused=None):
        directory = REMOTE + "/data/" + RUN_ID + "/" + self.temp.parent.name + "/" + self.temp.name
        args = ["--data-dir", directory, "--storage-poll-ms", "100", "--cluster-node",
                str(index + 1), "--cluster-listen", f"{HOSTS[index]}:{CONSENSUS}",
                "--cluster-secret-file", REMOTE + "/control/psk"]
        if self.settings.get("storage_tls", True):
            args += ["--cluster-tls-cert", REMOTE + "/control/node.crt",
                     "--cluster-tls-key", REMOTE + "/control/node.key",
                     "--cluster-tls-ca", REMOTE + "/control/peer.pem"]
        for other, host in enumerate(HOSTS):
            if other != index:
                args += ["--cluster-peer", f"{other + 1}@{host}:{CONSENSUS}"]
        return args

    def launch(self, index):
        global SERIAL
        SERIAL += 1
        binary = "sibuna-no-console" if self.name == "compiled_out" else "sibuna"
        args = [REMOTE + "/runtime/" + binary, "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--port", str(DATA),
                "--workers", "2", "--mode", self.settings["mode"], "--algorithm", "hashcash",
                "--difficulty", "8", "--shield", "--secret-file", REMOTE + "/control/seed",
                "--rate-limit", "2000000000", "--idle-timeout", "5", "--trust-forwarded",
                "--policy-file", REMOTE + "/control/policy.json"]
        if self.settings["mode"] == "reverse_proxy":
            args += ["--upstream-port", str(ORIGIN)]
        if self.consoles:
            args += ["--console", f"127.0.0.1:{CONSOLE}"] + self.mesh.args(index)
            if self.settings["capture_heads"]:
                args += ["--console-capture-heads"]
        args += self.cluster_args(index)
        name = f"{RUN_ID}-{self.temp.parent.name}-{self.temp.name}-n{index + 1}-{SERIAL}"
        proc = Process(index, name, args)
        self.procs.append(proc)
        if index == 0:
            self.target_proc = proc

    def start(self):
        self.launch(1)
        self.launch(2)
        if self.console_port:
            result = ssh(0, [REMOTE + "/runtime/sibuna", "init-admin", "admin"] +
                         self.cluster_args(0), timeout=150)
            match = re.search(r"Temporary console password .*: ([0-9a-f]{48})", result.stderr)
            assert match, "initializer did not return a temporary credential"
            self.credentials = {"username": "admin", "password": match[1]}
        self.launch(0)
        for index, pair in enumerate(PORTS):
            self.ready_port(pair[0])
        if self.console_port:
            self.dashboards()

    @staticmethod
    def ready_port(port):
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 120
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            try:
                if impact.request(port, "/__sibuna/health")[0] == 200:
                    return
            except (OSError, http.client.HTTPException):
                pass
            time.sleep(0.2)
        raise TimeoutError("remote node did not become healthy")

    def stop_all(self):
        failures = impact.stop_clients(self.clients)
        for proc in self.procs:
            try:
                proc.stop()
            except Exception as error:
                failures.append(error)
        if failures:
            raise RuntimeError("remote fixture cleanup failed") from failures[0]


def sample(daemon, path, hdrs, load, script):
    value = {"port": DATA, "pid": daemon.target_proc.pid, "path": path,
             "headers": hdrs, "load": load}
    agent(0, "warmup", value)
    peers_before = daemon.mesh.snapshot(daemon.cookie) if daemon.mesh else []
    before = [client.snapshot() for client in daemon.clients]
    result = agent(0, "sample", value)
    after = [client.snapshot() for client in daemon.clients]
    peers_after = daemon.mesh.snapshot(daemon.cookie) if daemon.mesh else []
    return {**result, "dashboards": difference(before, after),
            "peers": {"before": peers_before, "after": peers_after,
                      "covered": peers.coverage(peers_before, peers_after,
                                                result["wall_seconds"]) if daemon.mesh else None}}


def tunnels():
    for index, host in enumerate(HOSTS):
        ports = impact.free_port(), impact.free_port()
        PORTS.append(ports)
        args = ["ssh", "-o", "BatchMode=yes", "-o", "ExitOnForwardFailure=yes", "-N",
                "-L", f"{ports[0]}:127.0.0.1:{DATA}",
                "-L", f"{ports[1]}:127.0.0.1:{CONSOLE}", f"insan@{host}"]
        log = (CACHE / f"tunnel-{index}.log").open("w")
        proc = subprocess.Popen(args, stdout=log, stderr=log)
        TUNNELS.append((proc, log))
        time.sleep(0.5)
        assert proc.poll() is None, "SSH tunnel failed"


def infrastructure():
    for index, host in enumerate(HOSTS):
        Process(index, RUN_ID + "-tls-ingress", [REMOTE + "/runtime/caddy", "run", "--config",
                                       REMOTE + "/control/Caddyfile"])
        Process(index, RUN_ID + "-origin", [REMOTE + "/runtime/caddy", "respond", "--listen",
                                  f"127.0.0.1:{ORIGIN}", "--body", "origin"])
    time.sleep(1)


def run_matrix(mode, capture, rounds, seconds):
    directory = CACHE / RUN_ID / f"three-host-{mode}-{capture}"
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    binaries = {"console": {"path": "sibuna"}, "compiled_out": {"path": "sibuna-no-console"}}
    load = {"threads": 2, "connections": 32, "seconds": seconds, "warmup_seconds": 2}
    names = ("admitted", "challenged", "denied", "policy_reload")
    if capture:
        names += ("audited",)
    settings = {"mode": mode, "capture_heads": capture}
    started = time.monotonic()
    results, dashboards = impact.matrix(binaries, directory, load, rounds, True, names,
                                         None, None, None, settings)
    if not (dashboards["delivered"] and dashboards["geoip_available"] and
            dashboards["peers_covered"]):
        results["verdict"] = "inconclusive"
    record = {"meta": {"git": impact.metadata.__globals__["command"]("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"),
                       "date": __import__("datetime").datetime.now(
                           __import__("datetime").timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                       "cluster": True, "physical_hosts": 3, "mode": mode,
                       "capture_heads": capture, "load_generator": HOSTS[0],
                       "resource_target_node": 1, "environments": ENVIRONMENTS,
                       "source_provenance": json.loads((CACHE / "source-provenance.json").read_text()),
                       "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started},
              "gate": impact.GATE, "load": {**load, "rounds": rounds},
              "dashboards": dashboards, **results,
              "limitations": ["Three unprivileged containers on separate physical hosts.",
                              "Node 1 and wrk share a host; policy/telemetry cross the real LAN.",
                              "Dashboard clients run on the Mac through SSH tunnels; measured HTTP does not.",
                              "Governors and external host activity cannot be controlled.",
                              "Mutual TLS consensus and certificate-validated TLS management transport."]}
    name = f"console-impact-three-host-{mode}-capture-{'on' if capture else 'off'}.json"
    (CACHE / RUN_ID / name).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(name, results["verdict"], flush=True)


def close():
    failures = []
    for proc in reversed(PROCESSES):
        try:
            proc.stop()
        except Exception as error:
            failures.append(str(error))
    for proc, log in TUNNELS:
        proc.terminate()
        proc.wait(timeout=10)
        log.close()
    if failures:
        raise RuntimeError("; ".join(failures))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--rounds", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=int, default=15)
    parser.add_argument("--diagnose", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    impact.Daemon, impact.sample = Daemon, sample
    try:
        ENVIRONMENTS.extend(agent(index, "environment") for index in range(3))
        tunnels()
        infrastructure()
        if args.diagnose:
            directory = CACHE / RUN_ID / "diagnose" / "idle"
            directory.mkdir(parents=True)
            daemon = Daemon("idle", "sibuna", directory, True, None, None,
                            {"mode": "forward_auth", "capture_heads": False})
            try:
                daemon.start()
                print("Management directions current:", json.dumps(
                    daemon.mesh.snapshot(daemon.cookie)), flush=True)
            finally:
                daemon.stop_all()
            return
        for mode in ("forward_auth", "reverse_proxy"):
            for capture in (False, True):
                run_matrix(mode, capture, args.rounds, args.seconds)
    finally:
        close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

                       "source_provenance": source,
                       "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started},
              "gate": impact.GATE, "load": {**load, "rounds": rounds},
              "dashboards": dashboards, **results,
              "limitations": ["Three unprivileged containers on separate physical hosts.",
                              "Node 1 and wrk share a host; policy/telemetry cross the real LAN.",
                              "Dashboard clients run on the Mac through SSH tunnels; measured HTTP does not.",
                              "Governors and external host activity cannot be controlled.",
                              "Mutual TLS consensus and certificate-validated TLS management transport."]}
    name = f"console-impact-three-host-{mode}-capture-{'on' if capture else 'off'}.json"
    (CACHE / RUN_ID / name).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(name, results["verdict"], flush=True)


def close():
    failures = []
    for proc in reversed(PROCESSES):
        try:
            proc.stop()
        except Exception as error:
            failures.append(str(error))
    for proc, log in TUNNELS:
        proc.terminate()
        proc.wait(timeout=10)
        log.close()
    if failures:
        raise RuntimeError("; ".join(failures))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--rounds", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=int, default=15)
    parser.add_argument("--diagnose", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=("forward_auth", "reverse_proxy"))
    parser.add_argument("--capture", choices=("off", "on"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    impact.Daemon, impact.sample = Daemon, sample
    try:
        ENVIRONMENTS.extend(agent(index, "environment") for index in range(3))
        tunnels()
        infrastructure()
        if args.diagnose:
            directory = CACHE / RUN_ID / "diagnose" / "idle"
            directory.mkdir(parents=True)
            daemon = Daemon("idle", "sibuna", directory, True, None, None,
                            {"mode": "forward_auth", "capture_heads": False})
            try:
                daemon.start()
                print("Management directions current:", json.dumps(
                    daemon.mesh.snapshot(daemon.cookie)), flush=True)
            finally:
                daemon.stop_all()
            return
        modes = (args.mode,) if args.mode else ("forward_auth", "reverse_proxy")
        captures = (args.capture == "on",) if args.capture else (False, True)
        for mode in modes:
            for capture in captures:
                run_matrix(mode, capture, args.rounds, args.seconds)
    finally:
        close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Functional acceptance on three actual hosts using the isolated cluster controller."""
import base64
import contextlib
import hashlib
import http.client
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import ssl
import struct
import time
from types import SimpleNamespace
import cluster as c
import console_rule_hit_cluster_test as history
from console_topics_client import Client
from console_ws_test import Stream


def wait(predicate, label, seconds=60):
    deadline, last = time.monotonic() + seconds, None
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        try:
            last = predicate()
            if last:
                return last
        except (OSError, http.client.HTTPException, AssertionError) as error:
            last = str(error)
        time.sleep(0.5)
    raise AssertionError(f"{label}: {last}")


def console(d, index, method, path, body=None, session=None):
    cookie, csrf = session or (d.cookie, d.csrf)
    status, headers, raw = d.mesh.request(c.PORTS[index][1], method, path, body, cookie, csrf)
    return status, json.loads(raw) if raw else {}


def page(d, index):
    status, value = console(d, index, "GET", "/console/api/nodes")
    assert status == 200, (status, value)
    return value


def process(d, index):
    return next(proc for proc in reversed(d.procs) if proc.index == index)


def challenge_checks(d):
    cookie, solution = c.impact.session(c.PORTS[0][0])
    for port, _ in c.PORTS:
        assert c.impact.request(port, "/private", c.impact.headers(cookie=cookie))[0] == 200
        assert c.impact.request(port, "/?q=%27%20OR%201%3D1--",
                                c.impact.headers(cookie=cookie))[0] == 403
    assert c.impact.request(c.PORTS[1][0], "/__sibuna/verify", c.impact.headers(),
                            "POST", solution)[0] == 400
    print("PASS shared work-bound sessions, issuer-bound proofs, WAF on every node", flush=True)


def policy_checks(d):
    status, value = console(d, 0, "POST", "/console/api/policies/query", {})
    assert status == 200
    document = {"id": "cluster-rule", "name": "Cluster rule", "action": "deny",
                "path": "/cluster-rule"}
    body = {"expected_revision": value["committed"], "document": json.dumps(document)}
    status, saved = console(d, 0, "POST", "/console/api/policies/edit", body)
    assert status == 200, (status, saved)
    assert console(d, 1, "POST", "/console/api/policies/edit", body)[0] == 409
    revision = int(saved["committed"])
    wait(lambda: all(int(member["applied_revision"]) >= revision for member in
                     page(d, 0)["page"]["members"]), "all applied revisions")
    for port, _ in c.PORTS:
        assert c.h.request(port, "GET", "/cluster-rule", extra_headers={
            "X-Forwarded-For": "8.8.9.7", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})[0] == 403
    adapter = SimpleNamespace(data=[p[0] for p in c.PORTS], consoles=[p[1] for p in c.PORTS],
                              wait=lambda predicate, seconds, label: wait(predicate, label, seconds))
    captured = history.capture(adapter, d.mesh, (d.cookie, d.csrf), revision)
    print("PASS policy CAS, replication, applied revisions, persisted rule observations", flush=True)
    return adapter, captured


def failover_checks(d):
    leader = wait(lambda: page(d, 0)["page"]["storage"]["leader"], "leader") - 1
    survivor = (leader + 1) % 3
    process(d, leader).stop()
    wait(lambda: page(d, survivor)["page"]["storage"]["leader"] not in (None, leader + 1),
         "leader failover")
    status, policies = console(d, survivor, "POST", "/console/api/policies/query", {})
    assert status == 200
    document = {"id": "failover-rule", "name": "Failover rule", "action": "deny",
                "path": "/failover-rule"}
    status, result = console(d, survivor, "POST", "/console/api/policies/edit",
                            {"expected_revision": policies["committed"],
                             "document": json.dumps(document)})
    assert status == 200, (status, result)
    other = next(index for index in range(3) if index not in (leader, survivor))
    wait(lambda: c.h.request(c.PORTS[other][0], "GET", "/failover-rule", extra_headers={
         "X-Forwarded-For": "8.8.9.8", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})[0] == 403,
         "survivor applied edit")
    d.launch(leader)
    d.ready_port(c.PORTS[leader][0])
    wait(lambda: c.peers.current(d.mesh.snapshot(d.cookie)), "management peers recovered")
    print("PASS leader loss, survivor write, rejoin, advancing authenticated TLS peers", flush=True)


def management_stream():
    key = c.fixture.proof(bytes.fromhex((c.CACHE / "peer.key").read_text()), b"key", b"")
    ws_key = os.urandom(16)
    transcript = struct.pack("!IIQ", 2, 1, int(time.time())) + os.urandom(32) + ws_key
    signature = c.fixture.proof(key, b"client", transcript)
    stream = Stream.__new__(Stream)
    context = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(c.CACHE / "peer.pem"))
    stream.sock = context.wrap_socket(socket.create_connection((c.HOSTS[0], c.TLS), timeout=10),
                                     server_hostname="agy01.incus")
    stream.file = stream.sock.makefile("rb")
    stream.sock.sendall((f"GET /console/peer HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: agy01.incus:{c.TLS}\r\n"
                        "Connection: Upgrade\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\n"
                        f"Sec-WebSocket-Key: {base64.b64encode(ws_key).decode()}\r\n"
                        f"X-Sibuna-Peer: {transcript.hex()}\r\n"
                        f"X-Sibuna-Proof: {signature.hex()}\r\n\r\n").encode())
    assert int(stream.file.readline().split()[1]) == 101
    headers = {}
    while (line := stream.file.readline()) != b"\r\n":
        assert line
        name, value = line.decode().split(":", 1)
        headers[name.lower()] = value.strip()
    identity = bytes.fromhex(headers["x-sibuna-peer"])
    assert bytes.fromhex(headers["x-sibuna-proof"]) == c.fixture.proof(
        key, b"server", transcript + identity)
    return Client.from_stream(stream)


def quorum_checks(d):
    for index in (1, 2):
        process(d, index).stop()
    time.sleep(2)
    started = time.monotonic()
    status, body = console(d, 0, "POST", "/console/api/policies/edit",
                           {"expected_revision": "1", "document": "{}"})
    assert status == 503 and time.monotonic() - started < 15, (status, body)
    assert "CONSOLEQUORUM" in json.dumps(body)
    assert c.impact.request(c.PORTS[0][0], "/__sibuna/health")[0] == 200
    assert c.h.request(c.PORTS[0][0], "GET", "/cluster-rule", extra_headers={
        "X-Forwarded-For": "8.8.9.9", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})[0] == 403
    client = management_stream()
    try:
        client.command("sub", "stats")
        client.until(lambda: "stats" in client.states)
        first = client.states["stats"]["timestamp"]
        client.until(lambda: client.states["stats"]["timestamp"] >= first + 12)
        assert client.states["stats"]["node"] == 1 and not client.gaps
    finally:
        client.close()
    for index in (1, 2):
        d.launch(index)
        d.ready_port(c.PORTS[index][0])
    wait(lambda: c.peers.current(d.mesh.snapshot(d.cookie)), "quorum and peers rejoined", 90)
    print("PASS lost quorum refuses writes, cached protection and management stream continue", flush=True)


def revocation_checks(d):
    other_session = d.mesh.login(2)
    assert console(d, 2, "GET", "/console/api/session", session=other_session)[0] == 200
    assert console(d, 0, "POST", "/console/api/logout", {}, other_session)[0] == 200
    wait(lambda: console(d, 2, "GET", "/console/api/session", session=other_session)[0] == 401,
         "cross-node revocation")
    status, node = console(d, 1, "GET", "/console/api/nodes/local")
    assert status == 200
    command = dict(id=node["operation_id"], node=node["node"], boot=node["boot"],
                   expected_revision=str(node["control_revision"]), kind="drain")
    status, result = console(d, 1, "POST", "/console/api/nodes/command", command)
    assert status == 200 and result["state"] == "applied", result
    assert c.impact.request(c.PORTS[1][0], "/__sibuna/health")[0] == 503
    assert c.impact.request(c.PORTS[0][0], "/__sibuna/health")[0] == 200
    wait(lambda: console(d, 0, "POST", "/console/api/nodes/command/read",
                         {"id": command["id"]})[0] == 200, "replicated command receipt")
    print("PASS replicated revocation, local drain and replicated receipt", flush=True)


def main():
    directory = c.CACHE / c.RUN_ID / "functional" / "active"
    directory.mkdir(parents=True)
    daemon = None
    try:
        c.tunnels()
        c.infrastructure()
        daemon = c.Daemon("active", "sibuna", directory, True, None, None,
                          {"mode": "forward_auth", "capture_heads": True})
        daemon.start()
        assert c.peers.current(daemon.mesh.snapshot(daemon.cookie))
        assert not c.impact.stop_clients(daemon.clients)
        daemon.clients = []
        challenge_checks(daemon)
        adapter, captured = policy_checks(daemon)
        failover_checks(daemon)
        quorum_checks(daemon)
        history.recovered(adapter, daemon.mesh, 0, (daemon.cookie, daemon.csrf), captured)
        revocation_checks(daemon)
        print("PASS three actual host functional acceptance", flush=True)
    finally:
        try:
            if daemon is not None:
                daemon.stop_all()
        finally:
            c.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
